summary: The root حنجر (Hnjr) is mentioned in dictionaries like the K as a quadriliteral root.
lane: حَنْجَرَهُ حنجر حنجره حنجرة , here mentioned in the K: see art. حجر , in which I have mentioned it as Q. Q., like the two words here following, which are mentioned in the latter art. in the S and K &c.

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
